package.name: biguasim_interfaces
package.description: BiguaSim simulator custom message types (ImagingSonar, DVLSensorRange), rebuilt field-for-field from the schema embedded in a recorded BiguaSim rosbag. Use this only until the upstream biguasim_interfaces package is available in the container (install_biguasim.sh) -- if it is, delete this package so there is a single definition.
